newsitem.title: USA: Oryx Energy brings Neptune field on stream.
newsitem.headline: Oryx Energy brings Neptune field on stream.

text.p: Oryx Energy Co said Monday that it has begun producing at its Neptune project in the Gulf of Mexico. The company said production from its first well is running at 4,800 equivalent barrels per day (EBD), while facility commissioning is being completed.
Peak production of about 25,000 EBD is expected by late summer, said the company, as six additional pre-drilled wells are completed.

A second production peak of betweeen 25,000 EBD and 30,000 EBD is expected in 1999 with additional drilling, said the company, which estimates that gross reserves are between 50 million and 75 million barrels of oil equivalents.
The Neptune filed is located 80 miles south of Mobile, Ala. Oryx is the operator and owner of a 50 percent interest in the unit. Consolidated Natural Gas Co owns the remaining 50 percent.
